Sai Sudharsan Ruled Out of India's Sri Lanka Test Series Due to Injury

Sai Sudharsan has been ruled out of India's upcoming Test series against Sri Lanka due to a foot injury. He failed to recover from the niggle, leading to his exclusion. Shaik Rasheed and Sarfaraz Khan are reportedly the frontrunners to replace him in the squad. Rasheed's recent India A performance and positive feedback are noted as potential factors in selection.
